findings.failure_scenario: The four streams land rebased commits on main, and those commits never run the local hooks. As a result: (a) `check-checkpoint.mjs --commit` fails for d029982 (8/8) and 533b0a0 (9/8), and the CI gates workflow is red on main at both ('per-commit message gates'). (b) e8185ce landed with a failing harness-tests leg (pack-goldens.test.mjs was missing from SOURCE_HARNESS), and 03918b9 had to repair main. (c) ba60342, e8185ce, 03918b9 and d029982 each add their own task's digest line. review.mjs record appends that line after hashing the staged diff, so the committed diff cannot be the reviewed one. (d) None of the 10 landed diffs in 2d6a63e..533b0a0 hashes (git diff --binary) to any digest.log entry. Across all of M18, 2 of 81 match (abe812d, 8026874). Non-negotiable 4's binding therefore cannot be checked from history. A conflict resolution made during a rebase lands unreviewed. M18.36 r4 was re-reviewed after rebasing over cp10 and was then rebased again over e8185ce.

The cp10 disposition said M18.99 'SHALL land before further parallel-stream task commits'. It is still todo after 9 more task commits. Tracked pass lines are missing for M18.95 (now two checkpoints late), M18.37 and M18.48. The M18.95 F1 argued line, which the cp10 F6 disposition relies on, is still absent from review-argued.txt. Done rows M18.100, M18.102, M18.36, M18.37 and M18.48 have empty Commit cells, a third recurrence after cp9 F2 and cp10 F7. Also, M18.99 as written ('a tracked pass digest line for its diff') cannot pass by hash under rebased landings (F1d), so the leg needs a rebase-stable binding.

The review minor on M18.37 is still live: `replacing` stays true when the selection is cleared, because replaceMode = replacing && canReplace only masks it. A user toggles Replace, deselects, and later selects another shape. Their next plain click in the library then replaces that shape instead of inserting a new one. The commit says the fix comes 'with the My shapes panel row', but M18.34 and M18.35 do not mention it and no argued line exists, so the deferral is untracked.

The streams built two pack encoders. M18.102's SDK buildShapePackFiles writes insertion-order 2-space JSON, hashes with core's sync sha256, does no validation and keeps def.category verbatim. M18.101's format importedShapePack writes sorted-key canonicalJson, hashes through the injected port, validates and slugifies categories. The same pack gives different category bytes and hashes. M18.101's row says M18.29 'SHALL reuse this path', but ADR-0194 and checkShapePack require exactly the buildShapePackFiles output, so icons-lucide cannot satisfy both. Other rows also lag. M18.81 still names the 'ADR-0193 suite' and does not own lifting importedShapePack's refusal of font-bearing entries ('until the 1.1 font path'). M18.105 lists draw.io, but only Iconify has a provenance helper, and draw.io libraries declare no license.

Pack versions are hand-kept VERSION constants that must equal package.json, and the packs are public (changesets privatePackages.version is false). Running `changeset version` for release bumps @fluxion/pack-* to 0.1.0 (pending minor changesets) while VERSION stays '0.0.0', so every pack test fails in the release step. Before release, any geometry change at 0.0.0 fails 'release the change as a new pack version' until someone bumps package.json by hand, outside changesets. M18.103's retrofit is the first row likely to hit this. Separately, deleting the ledger entry and then doing a write run re-records new hashes at the same version, and no gate notices.

The m18-complete leg 'pinned font binaries rebuild identically and retain notices' skips the rebuild unless FLUXION_FONT_ENGINE_SOURCES and emsdk 6.0.13 are present, which they are in neither CI nor the gate. It then checks only manifest-recorded 'reproductions' that the author wrote. Spot mutant: replace woff2-codec.wasm with any build that has the same imports and update the manifest's sha256, bytes and reproductions. Every leg stays green, although M18.48's EARS requires reproducing binary hashes.

m18-complete tests() and verifyLeg pass process.env through, and only the harness probe deletes VITE_FLUXION_WRITE_PACK. If that variable is set in the shell from a regeneration, the 12 pack legs take the WRITE branch: a missing golden is written and passes, and orphan goldens and ledger or version problems are not checked. That reopens cp10 F1 for gate runs.
